## Page pg1

What has been your favorite part about senior year?

I'd say football and just like getting to spend lots of time with my friends and the coaches. The new coaching staff and everything that we've had and just the leaders in the school, it's been a fun one for sure.

If you could go anywhere in the world, where would you go and why?

I'd probably go to Rome just because of the Colosseum and the Gladiator. I love Gladiator, it's a wonderful movie. You know Rome is like an ancient powerhouse in the whole entire world. It's a really cool place to go.

After you graduate, where do you want to go or what do you want to do?

I'm going to be a firefighter in college station. I'm excited for that. I don't want football to fly by. I want to enjoy the days. Then in spring, get prepared for the fire fire academy and go be a firefighter.

Who has helped you become who you are today?

I'd probably say first and foremost, my Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Then friends, coaches, and my family
